# Distillate: Annual Water Report 2026

The garden's annual report documents the introduction of plot metering and the observed drop in water use.

## Core statements

- Water meters were installed on all plots in January 2025. [[10_markdown/documents/report-garden-water-2026#^a1b2]] ^s1
- Water use fell from 1000 to 686 cubic metres between 2024 and 2025. [[10_markdown/documents/report-garden-water-2026#^c3d4]] ^s2
- The board itself attributes part of the reduction to a wet summer. [[10_markdown/documents/report-garden-water-2026#^e5f6]] ^s3

## Terms

## Open questions

- The report gives no plot-level breakdown of the reduction.

## Appraisal

The report is the board's own account of a measure the board decided, so it is an interested party on the question of that measure's effect. Its figures are consistent with the meter readings held as a data source, which is what makes it usable at all. For this vault it carries the narrative of the metering year; the causal claim it suggests is left to the assertion layer, where the wet summer the report itself names has to be weighed against it.
